amendments.requirement: Unknown data is explicit and never replaced with fabricated values.
amendments.problem: Early source archive preparation failure/cancellation can occur before any trusted manifest hash is known, but the original schema required a hash.
amendments.change: source_manifest_hash is nullable for failed/cancelled preparation; passed still requires64hex. Existing reason/outcome discriminators explain missing value.
amendments.verification: Independent review accepted A001; Source13 early cancellation/index-hash-failure reports and Foundation10 passed-with-null rejection passed. All three amended design validators passed. Final M1A integration gate remains separate.

amendments.requirement: In-process C# uses the same typed compiler facts without false Clang metadata.
amendments.problem: Existing frozen native envelope requires native worker name and clang_version; reusing it verbatim for Roslyn would fabricate producer provenance.
amendments.change: Add semantic-facts and semantic-unit-result schemas by JSON Pointer references to unchanged native property schemas; explicit transport-neutral producer metadata. Common semantic validation follows schema checks. Common semantic-entity references every native property but permits null linkage for C#; language-aware common validation enforces applicability. Native wire is unchanged.

amendments.requirement: Structured function types retain precise signatures without arbitrary callable ownership.
amendments.problem: Native direct-call decay includes function/pointer types, but signature identity only permitted a named callable owner despite existing function_type vocabulary.
amendments.change: Add function_type_id signature components alternative; preserve entity-owned recipe; abstract parameters and body absence explicitly applicable. SQL and native wire unchanged.

amendments.requirement: Preserve captured native pragma directive without dropping or relabeling compiler evidence.
amendments.problem: Native wire preprocessing enum already admits pragma and actual pilot emits pragma once, but canonical SQL/dictionary omitted this enum member.
amendments.change: Add pragma to preprocessing.event_kind SQL CHECK and dictionary enum. No new column or wire shape. M1B opens a newly created collecting generation; old M1A schema is not silently migrated.
